_README: PER-MACHINE SETTINGS -- NOT PART OF THE PORTABLE PROJECT (requirement 70).
Copy this file to  Source/Config/local.settings.json  and edit it for YOUR PC.
The scripts create that copy automatically on first run if it is missing.
local.settings.json must never be included in a release package or handed to
another developer: it contains paths and port numbers that are only correct on
one machine. Everything portable belongs in board_e310_v1.json instead.
Leave a value as null or "" to let the scripts auto-detect it.

toolchain._comment: Target toolchain is Vivado/Vitis 2023.2. On Linux, source /tools/Xilinx/Vivado/2023.2/settings64.sh and /tools/Xilinx/Vitis/2023.2/settings64.sh before running Automation/Linux/build_all.sh; that script uses whatever is on PATH. Leave install_root null to auto-detect.

build._comment: Parallel jobs for synthesis and implementation. Match your CPU, not the machine this template came from.
build._comment_version_override: Vendor/ADI_hdl_2023_r2 expects Vivado 2023.2, so no override is needed. build_all.sh exports REQUIRED_VIVADO_VERSION=2023.2 anyway. Set force_required_version only if you deliberately run a different version.

jtag._comment: Leave hw_server_url null to start a local hw_server. Set target_filter only if more than one device is on the chain; run HardwareTests/JTAG/Detect-JtagChain.ps1 first to see what is actually connected.
jtag._expected_idcode_note: Fill this in from a real Detect-JtagChain.ps1 run against your board. Do not copy a value from documentation.

uart._comment: E310 V1 console is PS UART1 on MIO 12/13 at 921600 baud (from the vendor firmware). The COM number is whatever Windows assigns on YOUR machine -- run HardwareTests/UART/Detect-ComPorts.ps1 to find it.

gnss_receiver._comment: The external GNSS module used to validate the retransmitted signal (requirements 53, 56). Its COM port is separate from the E310 console port.

_comment: SAFETY-RELEVANT. Requirements 54 and 55: initial GNSS validation is a
CONDUCTED test over coax with attenuation, not an over-the-air
retransmission. Record the real attenuator value actually fitted.
These are null on purpose. Nothing in this project computes a safe TX
power for you, and no script will transmit until they are filled in.
